title: Sometimes, Always, Never: Regulatory Clarity and the Development of Digital Financing
authors: Zhenkai Ran; P. Raghavendra Rau; Tania Ziegler
near_miss_reason: A staggered binary design exists (country-level introduction of crowdfunding regulation, P2P_year_recip spanning 2012-2020, with 144 never-regulated countries; eventdd event studies with country and year FE), but every binary specification - the eventdd figures (lines 4499-4649) and the lead/lag reghdfe pre-trend tests (lines 4539-4677) - includes 13 lagged time-varying country controls. The main tables (5-12) use a continuous regulatory-clarity index (P2P_RegIndex_pub_L_recip, 0-43) interacted with a switcher indicator, plus controls, and Table 11 Panel C uses a PSM-matched sample; none is a binary no-controls TWFE.
eligible_reason: Not eligible as reported: binary regulation-introduction event studies always carry time-varying controls (near miss); main regressions use a continuous regulation index with controls.
design_notes: Country-year panel 2015-2020 (202 countries, 1,212 rows) of crowdfunding volumes and platform counts; regindex file provides continuous P2P/ECF regulation indices, binary indicators (P2P_Binary_pub_recip), switcher flags (Switcher_P2P_recip = 29 countries) and regulation years (P2P_year_recip: 2012 (5), 2014 (3), 2015 (8), 2016 (7), 2017 (4), 2018 (5), 2019 (5), 2020 (21), 0 = never (144)). Main spec (Table 5A col 1, line 159): reghdfe lntotal_adfin_dom P2P_RegIndex_pub_L_recip Switcher_P2P_recip P2P_RegIndex_Switcher_recip RL_EST_L_recip lngdp_L_recip if year >= 2015, a(Recipient_country year) vce(cluster Recipient_country##year). The code merges a 'control_variables' dataset that is NOT in the package, so the controls (RL_EST, lngdp, Doing Business, banking, mobile usage) cannot be reconstructed; platform-level data (Table 8, Table 11 Panel C Part II) are confidential and not shipped. The package directory also contains a second folder, replication_package_MS-ACC-23-00318, which belongs to a different paper (lab experiments on recognition systems and help-seeking; SPSS/Stata) and appears to be a download mismatch.
estimators_reported: TWFE with continuous regulation index x switcher interaction and controls (Tables 5-7, 9-12)
eventdd event studies on binary regulation introduction with controls (figures)
lead/lag reghdfe pre-trend tests with controls

n_adoption_cohorts_note: In-sample (2015-2020) regulation years 2015-2020 (6 cohorts; 2020 adopters are excluded from event studies because treatment starts 2021 in the main regressions); 2012 and 2014 adopters are always treated; 144 countries never regulated.
reports_modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags cite Callaway-Sant'Anna and Baker et al., but no modern estimator is implemented in the code.

data_access_detail: Country-level crowdfunding and regulation-index files shipped; the merged control_variables dataset and the platform-level dataset are not included.
data_files_note: control_variables.dta (all covariates) and crowdfunding_platform_level_2015_2020.dta are referenced by the code but absent.
replication_feasible_note: A no-controls binary event study/TWFE could be run from the two shipped files (outcomes, P2P_year_recip), but it would not correspond to any reported specification.
screener_notes: Flag for lead: package_dir contains an unrelated second replication package (MS-ACC-23-00318, help-seeking experiments) alongside the correct MS_replication_package folder. Output logs (country_level_regression.log, platform_level_regression.log) are included and contain the authors' estimates if published numbers are needed.
